candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway checkout. Traces show payment 503 errors across all three correlation IDs while inventory/reservations succeed, localizing the failure to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics are available; the internal cause of payment 503 (config, saturation, dependency) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, which order relays as 502 and gateway surfaces as 502 on checkout. Inventory and reservations succeed, so the fault is localized to the payment dependency. Payment-internal cause remains unproven.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations to determine why it returns 503
Order service logs to confirm it surfaces payment 503 as 502 without its own fault
